premises.text: Under-$5k digital tools cannot cut hard flat materials well; makers resort to slow hand processes
premises.evidence_span: If you want to cut something hard and flat, you pretty much have to do it by hand

premises.text: Desktop waterjet cutter cuts any material with digital precision, is compact, clean, safe, quiet, and priced under $4,000
premises.evidence_span: Wazer is the first desktop waterjet cutter

premises.text: Technology pressurizes water with abrasive particles to erode material in seconds via ground-up redesign of industrial waterjetting
premises.evidence_span: we pressurize water. We combine it with abrasive sand-like particles at high velocity

premises.text: Diverse makers—jewelers, artisans, homeowners, makerspaces, students—need versatile hard-material cutting
premises.evidence_span: it's needed by lots of different types of makers

value.text: Makers digitally cut hard materials that other desktop tools cannot
value.evidence_span: It's a digital tool that uses water to cut through any material

secondary_value.text: Bring water-cutting technology into ordinary workshops
secondary_value.evidence_span: bringing this amazing technology to workshops everywhere

causal_links.evidence_span: that's what we're solving with Wazer
